description: Registered intermediary providing securities trading and broking services under SEBI regulations.

FILED.status_explanation: Your complaint has been submitted to the broker. At this point, the broker's system logs your issue.
FILED.recommended_action: Check your email/SMS or broker portal for a complaint acknowledgement number or ticket ID. Save this reference carefully.
suggested_documents: Copy of original complaint submitted (may be useful for your grievance record)
Order book / contract note / trade confirmation copy if applicable
FILED.escalation_path: Broker Customer Support / Grievance Redressal Officer (GRO)
FILED.conditions: Initial stage. Intermediary acknowledgement is awaited.
FILED.guidance_notes: Every SEBI-registered broker is required to maintain a designated investor grievance email address and redressal mechanism.
FILED.disclaimer: Official regulatory process information. Any simulated time windows are demo configurations for testing.

ACKNOWLEDGED.status_explanation: The broker has officially acknowledged receipt of your complaint and assigned an acknowledgement/ticket reference.
ACKNOWLEDGED.recommended_action: Note the ticket reference number. Upload or retain the acknowledgement receipt in your FlowGuard record.
suggested_documents: Broker acknowledgement receipt / email confirmation (may be useful for your grievance record)
Copy of original complaint (may be useful for your grievance record)
ACKNOWLEDGED.conditions: Complaint acknowledged. Intermediary is expected to investigate and respond.
ACKNOWLEDGED.guidance_notes: Brokers typically review records and transaction logs internally before providing a formal resolution.
ACKNOWLEDGED.disclaimer: Official regulatory process information. Any simulated time windows are demo configurations for testing.

AWAITING_RESPONSE.status_explanation: Your complaint is currently pending response or resolution from the stock broker.
AWAITING_RESPONSE.recommended_action: Monitor for updates from the broker. Keep your transaction statement and acknowledgement receipt ready in case the response is delayed.
suggested_documents: Broker acknowledgement receipt (may be useful for your grievance record)
Account / transaction statement reflecting disputed transaction (may be useful for your grievance record)
Copy of original complaint (may be useful for your grievance record)
AWAITING_RESPONSE.conditions: If the broker does not respond or resolve the issue within the configured response window (e.g. 30-day demo configuration), escalation may be initiated.
AWAITING_RESPONSE.guidance_notes: If the intermediary fails to respond within the expected window, investors can escalate to the Stock Exchange (NSE/BSE) or SEBI SCORES 2.0.
AWAITING_RESPONSE.disclaimer: Internal warning timestamps and time windows are demo configurations for simulation purposes, not statutory regulatory deadlines.

RESPONSE_RECEIVED.status_explanation: The stock broker has sent a formal response or proposed resolution for your complaint.
RESPONSE_RECEIVED.recommended_action: Review the response carefully. If satisfied, you can mark the case as resolved. If dissatisfied, you may seek further action or escalation.
suggested_documents: Broker response letter / email (may be useful for your grievance record)
Broker acknowledgement receipt (may be useful for your grievance record)
Account / transaction statement (may be useful for your grievance record)
RESPONSE_RECEIVED.escalation_path: Stock Exchange Investor Grievance Cell (NSE / BSE) or SEBI SCORES 2.0
RESPONSE_RECEIVED.conditions: If the response is unsatisfactory or incomplete, escalation to Stock Exchange or SCORES is available.
RESPONSE_RECEIVED.guidance_notes: Carefully assess whether the broker addressed all points in your original complaint before closing the matter.
RESPONSE_RECEIVED.disclaimer: Official regulatory process information. Any simulated time windows are demo configurations for testing.

RESOLVED.status_explanation: The complaint has been addressed and marked resolved.
RESOLVED.recommended_action: Verify that any required credits, reversals, or corrections reflect accurately in your ledger or Demat account.
suggested_documents: Final resolution confirmation from broker (may be useful for your personal records)
Updated account statement confirming credit or resolution (may be useful for your personal records)
RESOLVED.escalation_path: None required unless resolution is not honored
RESOLVED.conditions: Complaint resolved to the investor's satisfaction.
RESOLVED.guidance_notes: Keep copies of resolution letters for your annual financial and tax records.

FURTHER_ACTION.status_explanation: The complaint requires escalation to an official external grievance redressal mechanism.
FURTHER_ACTION.recommended_action: Prepare your grievance file (ticket ID, acknowledgement, transaction statements) and file an escalation on SEBI SCORES 2.0 or SMART ODR portal.
suggested_documents: Broker acknowledgement receipt (may be useful for your grievance record)
Account / transaction statement reflecting disputed transactions (may be useful for your grievance record)
Copy of original complaint (may be useful for your grievance record)
Broker response letter if received (may be useful for your grievance record)
Escalation filing receipt from SCORES / SMART ODR once submitted (may be useful for your grievance record)
FURTHER_ACTION.conditions: Applicable when the broker response is overdue (e.g. 30-day demo configuration lapsed) or when the broker's response is rejected by the investor.
FURTHER_ACTION.guidance_notes: Under SEBI regulations, unresolved investor grievances against brokers can be escalated through the 2-tier SCORES system and online dispute resolution (SMART ODR).
FURTHER_ACTION.disclaimer: Official regulatory process information. Any simulated time windows are demo configurations for testing.

response_window_exceeded.title: Response Window Exceeded Notice
response_window_exceeded.explanation: FlowGuard detected that the recorded elapsed time exceeds the configured window (e.g., 30-day demo configuration) with no broker response recorded.
response_window_exceeded.recommended_step: You may prepare to escalate to SEBI SCORES 2.0 or the SMART ODR portal using your complaint reference and acknowledgement receipt.

potential_delay.title: Potential Delay Notice
potential_delay.explanation: Progress on this complaint appears slower than the configured benchmark.
potential_delay.recommended_step: Send a polite follow-up inquiry to the broker's Grievance Redressal Officer citing your reference number.

awaiting_response.title: Awaiting Response Notice
awaiting_response.explanation: Complaint is within the expected response window and awaiting intermediary action.
awaiting_response.recommended_step: No action needed at this time. FlowGuard will monitor the timeline.
